Luis Portfolio Enhancement

Implementation Guide for Trae

Conflict-Free • Nav/Footer Safe

CRITICAL: Read This First

  • DO NOT modify existing CSS classes - we're adding NEW classes only
  • DO NOT touch nav or footer code - these enhancements are content-area only
  • Test on staging first - always test before pushing to production
  • Mobile responsive included - all classes work on mobile automatically

Files Provided

  • luis_enhancements.css - Main CSS file
  • reference_page.html - Working example
  • IMPLEMENTATION_GUIDE.html - This guide

Time Estimate

  • Step 1: 5 minutes
  • Step 2: 15 minutes
  • Step 3: 10 minutes testing
  • Total: ~30 minutes

1 Add CSS File (5 minutes)

Option A: Link External CSS (Recommended)

Add this line to your HTML head section, AFTER your existing CSS:

<link rel="stylesheet" href="path/to/luis_enhancements.css">

Option B: Inline CSS (If you prefer)

Copy the entire content of luis_enhancements.css and paste it inside:

<style>
/* Paste luis_enhancements.css content here */
</style>
⚠️ Important: Make sure this CSS loads AFTER your existing stylesheets so it can override when needed.

2 Update HTML Classes (15 minutes)

Hero Section Updates

Find your main "About. Luis Gilberto" heading and update:

// BEFORE:
<h1>About. Luis Gilberto</h1>

// AFTER:
<h1 class="luis-hero-title">About. Luis Gilberto</h1>

Find your tagline paragraph and update:

// BEFORE:
<p>I'm an integrated marketing strategist...</p>

// AFTER:
<p class="luis-tagline">I'm an integrated marketing strategist...</p>

Profile Card Enhancement

Find your profile card container and add the class:

// BEFORE:
<div class="existing-classes">
<img src="profile.jpg">
<h3>LUIS GILBERTO</h3>
<p>Integrated Marketing & Creative Strategy</p>
</div>

// AFTER:
<div class="existing-classes luis-profile-card">
<img src="profile.jpg">
<h3>LUIS GILBERTO</h3>
<p>Integrated Marketing & Creative Strategy</p>
</div>

Luis • Decoded Section

Update the section title:

// BEFORE:
<h2>Luis • Decoded</h2>

// AFTER:
<h2 class="luis-decoded-title">Luis • Decoded</h2>

Wrap the biographical content:

// BEFORE:
<p>Today you'll find me designing...</p>
<p>Speaking deeply...</p>
// ... more paragraphs

// AFTER:
<div class="luis-decoded-content">
<p>Today you'll find me designing...</p>
<p>Speaking deeply...</p>
// ... more paragraphs
</div>

Button Enhancement

Update your CTA buttons:

// BEFORE:
<a href="resume.pdf">View My Resume</a>
<a href="brand-guide.pdf">Brand Guide</a>

// AFTER:
<div class="luis-cta-buttons">
<a href="resume.pdf" class="luis-btn-primary">View My Resume</a>
<a href="brand-guide.pdf" class="luis-btn-secondary">Brand Guide</a>
</div>

Optional: Add Accent Lines

Replace any existing red lines with:

<hr class="luis-accent-line">

3 Testing Checklist (10 minutes)

✅ Desktop Testing

  • Hero title is larger and bold
  • Tagline has better spacing
  • Profile card has hover effect
  • "Luis • Decoded" has gradient text
  • Bio text is in two columns
  • Buttons have hover animations

📱 Mobile Testing

  • Text sizes scale properly
  • Bio text is single column
  • Buttons stack vertically
  • Profile card fits screen
  • No horizontal scrolling

🚨 If Something Breaks:

  1. Check the browser console for CSS conflicts
  2. Ensure luis_enhancements.css loads AFTER existing CSS
  3. Verify class names are spelled correctly
  4. Check that you didn't modify existing classes
  5. Test with !important removed if needed

Troubleshooting Guide

Problem: Gradient text not showing

Solution: Add webkit prefixes and check browser support

-webkit-background-clip: text;
-webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
background-clip: text;

Problem: Two-column layout not working

Solution: Check if CSS columns property is supported, add fallback

@supports (columns: 2) {
.luis-decoded-content {
columns: 2;
}
}

Problem: Buttons look weird

Solution: Check for existing button styles conflicting, add more specific selectors

/* Make selectors more specific */
.luis-cta-buttons .luis-btn-primary { ... }

Problem: Nav/Footer affected

Solution: These classes should NOT affect nav/footer. If they do, scope them better:

/* Scope to main content area only */
main .luis-hero-title { ... }
.about-page .luis-profile-card { ... }

Success Metrics

If implementation is successful, you should see:

  • Visual Impact: Page immediately feels more premium and engaging
  • Typography: Clear hierarchy with larger, more confident headings
  • Interactions: Smooth hover effects on cards and buttons
  • Content Flow: Biography text flows better with improved readability
  • Mobile Experience: Responsive design works seamlessly across devices

🎯 Ready to Launch?

After successful testing, deploy to production and watch engagement metrics!
